This incredible project is set on a 11.178 sqm plot with absolutely breathtaking views. It's a truly unique opportunity, sold with plans and an active building license for a stunning 2.443 sqm villa with 1.998 interior space.
The inspiration for the design was the plot's breathtaking location in a valley flanked by steep hills on either side, with uninterrupted views of the Mediterranean sea. The villa is built into the hill side, as if it almost becomes part of the environment, rather than just sitting on top of it. All the windows disappear into the walls, whereby nature is brought into the living spaces using water features, living walls, and natural materials. The design is inspired by the natural vegetation and used colors and materials that perfectly matched the decor of the villa. The valley is home to a wealth of naturally occurring dark stone, which has been incorporated into many of the wall finishes. This is a home that is truly integrated with its natural surroundings—it's absolutely amazing!
The finished villa will be distributed over three floors, with eight bedrooms (of which three are private suites with their own living and kitchen areas), 13 bathrooms (eight of which are part of ensuite, and two outdoor with outdoor showers), an outdoor pool and jacuzzi, an indoor pool and jacuzzi, a sauna, steam room, salon and medi-spa, and a gym! And there's still more! A bowling alley, cinema, beverage cellar, game room, library, chef's kitchen, show kitchen, living room, dining room, informal dining room, two English patios, a six-car garage, a three-car carport, a dedicated laundry room, a machine room, and a smart home equipped with ‌audio ‌throughout ‌indoor/outdoor ‌spaces! ‌Plus, ‌photovoltaic-powered water heating, ‌underfloor heating, a rain catch system ‌for irrigation, ‌water ‌recycling, and so much more!

Ultra-Prime South-Facing Estate | Avant-Garde Smart Technology | Commanding Sea, Mountain & Nature Reserve Views
Positioned in an extraordinary, elevated enclave within Europe’s most prestigious and secure gated residential resort, this trophy eight-bedroom villa in La Zagaleta, Benahavís, represents the pinnacle of contemporary Mediterranean luxury. Engineered according to the highest international building standards, the architecture masterfully balances sculptural form, tactile natural textures, and grand internal volume to deliver an uncompromising sanctuary of privacy, prestige, and comfort.

• Private Accommodation: Eight substantial bedroom suites and nine luxuriously appointed bathrooms ensure total comfort, seclusion, and independence for family members, visiting guests, and household staff alike.
The La Zagaleta Country Club Lifestyle
Set within a protected 900-hectare Mediterranean woodland reserve in the hills above Marbella, La Zagaleta offers an ultra-exclusive living environment protected by 24-hour armed security and strict controlled access. Residents enjoy privileged access to two championship private golf courses, an elegant members-only clubhouse, a private heliport, and a world-class equestrian centre—all located within a short drive ‌of ‌Marbella’s ‌Golden ‌Mile, ‌the ‌superyacht marina of ‌Puerto Banús, and premier international schools.

This exceptional property is set on a generous, elevated plot of 7,200 m² in the exclusive, gated Cascada de Camoján community in Marbella and offers breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. The basement of the main house houses four additional garage spaces, several storage rooms, and the property's utility rooms. Both the main house and the guest house have their own lavishly landscaped gardens and a heated pool – each completely independent of the other.

offers.description:
Exterior
Designed by AMES Arquitectos, Vill is newly completed and ready to move into. It occupies an elevated plot of 4,328 sqm surrounded by greenery, which gives privacy and a close connection to the landscape. The villa has open views across the surrounding countryside, mountains and La Zagaleta’s original golf course, with sea views from the upper floor. A gently sloping driveway leads to a landscaped forecourt. Outdoors, an L-shaped heated infinity pool with jacuzzi, a fire pit and shaded lounges sit within landscaped gardens, and generous terraces extend the living areas for dining.
Interior
The entrance hall opens to an open-plan living area with seven-metre ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glass walls that slide into the structure. A Modulnova kitchen with Gaggenau appliances flows into the dining and lounge areas and out to the terraces, with a secondary kitchen for entertaining. This level also holds a TV room and a bedroom suite. The upper floor holds the main suite in the south wing, with a fireplace, dressing room and terrace overlooking the sea, golf course and lake, and two further guest suites. The lower level comprises three bedroom suites, a wellness area with heated indoor pool, gym, sauna and hammam, an office, a climate-controlled wine cellar and a two-bedroom staff apartment with independent access. A home cinema and games room and a lift serving all floors complete the house. The garage, directly accessible from the forecourt, holds up to 15 cars, with a car lift and four EV charging points. The villa has aerothermal energy and solar panels, with underfloor heating throughout.
Location
Villa Hermes stands within La Zagaleta, a residential community with 24-hour security and access to two private golf courses, a clubhouse, an equestrian centre and a helipad. Marbella and the coast are within easy reach. The combination of architecture, setting and space supports long-term ownership.

Outside, expansive terraces lead towards the infinity swimming pool and landscaped gardens, with an outdoor kitchen and barbecue area designed for entertaining. The villa is offered fully furnished, making it a genuinely turnkey residence. The interiors and furniture have been selected to work with the architecture, allowing a new owner to move into a
completed home without the lengthy process of designing, building, furnishing and finishing a property of this scale.

course, racquet facilities and private beach club are nearby, as are Sotogrande International School, the Marina and the wider amenities of Sotogrande.
Villa brings together ARK architecture, approximately 1,589 m² of enclosed interior space, five en-suite bedrooms, comprehensive private wellness facilities, ‌an ‌exceptional ‌automotive ‌showroom, ‌panoramic ‌views and the ‌immediacy of a fully completed and ‌furnished home.

A Masterpiece of Elegance and Serenity
Discover timeless elegance in this exceptional villa located in Río Real, one of the most exclusive residential areas of Marbella.
Elevated on private hills, this residence offers panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the surrounding golf courses, enveloping every room in an atmosphere of beauty and tranquility.
Every detail has been carefully designed to reflect the perfect fusion between classic Andalusian charm and contemporary comforts, creating a welcoming, sophisticated and characterful environment.
Here, luxury is experienced through serenity: a safe and private enclave where each day offers a visual spectacle of golden sunsets and fascinating natural landscapes.
General Property Description
This exclusive estate combines spaciousness, elegance and privacy in an environment of absolute distinction.
Set on a plot of 5,175 m², it has a constructed area of 2,422 m², distributed between the main residence, an independent guest house and an auxiliary pavilion.
The property has 10 bedrooms and 10 bathrooms, offering an ideal space for both family life and the celebration of events or high-level stays.
A garage with capacity for four vehicles, spacious living areas, several lounges and a large swimming pool surrounded by landscaped gardens complete this oasis of comfort and privacy.
Distribution and Main Features
With a classic large-scale distribution, the property has been designed to offer spaciousness, comfort and a natural connection between interiors and exteriors, achieving a perfect balance between functionality and elegance.
Built area: 2,422 m²
Land: 5,175 m²
Bedrooms: 10
Bathrooms: 10
Main House – Ground Floor
The ground floor houses the main living and reception areas, with spacious lounges and a formal dining room arranged around a central patio with a fountain, which floods the interior spaces with light and freshness.
It includes several suites with direct access to terraces and the pool area, ideal for enjoying the Mediterranean climate and the peace of the surroundings.
Main House – First Floor
The upper floor houses the large master suite, conceived as a private retreat with an exclusive terrace, dressing room and relaxation area.
In addition, it has several additional bedrooms, carefully distributed to ensure privacy and fluidity in the interior routes.
Guest House
Completely independent, this secondary residence is distributed over two floors and offers additional bedrooms, lounges and a full kitchen, providing maximum comfort and autonomy for guests or staff.
Independent Pavilion
A versatile and bright building, perfect for use as a wellness and spa area, entertainment room, private gym or retreat-style bar, adding value to the residential experience.
Conclusion
Overall, this property represents one of the most exclusive residences in Río Real, a ‌perfect ‌combination ‌of ‌classic ‌architecture, ‌refined design and ‌privileged natural environment.
A villa designed for ‌those seeking ‌to ‌live with distinction, in a ‌framework ‌of ‌absolute ‌privacy, ‌comfort ‌and ‌beauty.
